notes.title: Galactic Federation Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657380/26b7bd742cc17153048918d2ffcbea86b3537203.jpg[/img]

The [b]Galactic Federation Update[/b] HAS ARRIVED! — a cosmic celebration based on humankind's euphoric feel with space! The 'Galactic Federation' is based on a space security chief's reports about alleged contact with extraterrestrials!

Starting today, 10th May 2022 - 8:00PM (GMT+2), you will discover multiple new space-themed items, a new map, a reworking of several items, and MORE!

The space-themed background and music will be removed on 30th May 2022. Everything else will remain permanently!

[h3][b]New space-themed items[/b]
[/h3]- Stickman Skins: Mantis + Pleiadian + Astronaut
- Weapon: Plasma Gun
- Throwable: Zapper
- Headgear: Third Eye

[h3][b]Lobby redesigned into a space theme[/b][/h3]
The game's Lobby will be temporarily redesigned to feature space-themed items.

[h3][b]A new BS1-inspired map[/b][/h3]
The Ancient Tower - a map based on a similar one in BattleStick (first version)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657380/3474d1a9bc17237bd82600e05ee2ac0bc5215b06.png[/img]

[h3][b]...and MORE![/b][/h3]
Halloween stickman skins, Heart Glasses, Stickiller's Fireworks Launcher are now permanently available. Also, redesigned the Ice Plains map by removing the 'corridors', reworked all melee weapons by increasing their range by 5px... and more changes can be found in the following changelog:

[code]- Added new CP map : The Ancient Tower (inspired by BS1)
- Added new stickman skins : Mantis, Pleiadian + Astronaut. Note: Halloween stickman skins are now permanently available
- Added new weapon : Plasma Gun
- Added new throwable : Zapper
- Added new headgear: Third Eye
- Added Technical FAQ : contains the commonly asked technical issues
- Returned Heart Glasses + Stickiller's Fireworks Launcher: now permanently available
- Redesigned Ice Plains : removed the 'corridors'
- Reworked melee weapons : increased range by 5px
- Reworked Javeline : fixed hitbox
- Reworked Magic Wand : removed wand's self-damage
- Reworked Gravitational Bomb : reworked the attractor's force
- Reworked Stickiller : reworked explosion effect for the Firework Launcher skin + fixed a bug where previously when you shot at the ground below you were pulled to the explosion.
- Reworked Leaderboard : increased number of results from 20 to 50
- Reworked camera : increased maximum zoom
- Reworked Chat System : Lobby chat is now visible while in-game. Use /l to type in battle + renamed (ROOM) chat to (BATTLE)
- Removed Wiki button and all its links in Shop
- Disabled Xsolla Diamonds Shop[/code]
See you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Introducing the new shield system
notes.notes:
The shield system is now available and allows you to play as a tank.
It will make your stickman more robust (+100 HP Bonus and +25 armor) during the whole game.

The shield system arrives with the first shield called the Spartan Shield. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657380/9b23a5e714e1f7471839c68200e0dd5a957cd8f5.jpg[/img]

It has a blocking skill that will increase your armor by +150 points for 1.5 seconds. 
If timed properly, you will be able to mitigate heavy damage and resist most light weapons (knives, stones, and even bows).

To celebrate the release of the shield system I also released a new skin for the short sword called "Kopis". It was mainly used during the Antiquity by the Greeks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657380/ee786879130819f6f77a6992616e7533dd432d8a.jpg[/img]

This update comes after a relative period of inactivity and I hope you will like it.

I'm looking forward to seeing you in-game!

notes.title: New Year's Eve Letter + Update!
notes.notes:
Stickmen!

It's been a great year for the BattleStick 2 community, a year of the release of BS2, highlighting vast differences compared to BattleStick.

BattleStick 2 was created with the intention of modernizing 2D graphics by upgrading to Phaser 3, learning from some technical and marketing mistakes, and of course adding more features. It took about 9 months of development till the Closed Beta Testing release on 24th April 2020, and the final revised Steam release on 24th September 2020.

While still being a relatively small community and not growing at an accelerated rate, the game is steadily growing, showing no major signs of slowing down.

We acknowledge our mistakes in areas such as balancing items and performance issues, but together we managed to resolve many of them thanks to your dedicated feedback!

Our efforts are focused on the usual of adding new items, fixing bugs, balancing issues, and making the game grow. We will be publishing gameplay videos on the BS1 and BS2 YouTube channels soon.

[h3][CHANGELOG] V2.1.0 — NEW YEAR'S EVE PATCH
[/h3][code]- Added new headgear : New Year's Hat
- Reworked Daggers : increased damage inflicted from 125 to 145[/code]
[b]The staff of BattleStick 2 wish you prosperity throughout the coming year of 2021. Thank you for your support in keeping the game going on![/b]

notes.title: Stickmas 2020
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657380/d035d36b31ee589d8712b74528a1f78dcc4f1c4a.png[/img]

Ho-ho-ho Stickmen!

It's the most iconic time of the year, the time where family and friends gather together to celebrate and receive gifts. 

Here, in BattleStick 2, we have planned two weeks of jolly-fun!

Stickmas 2020 kicks off TODAY 21st December - 5:00 PM (GMT+1) till 4th January - 5:00 PM (GMT+1). Here are all the things we've prepared!

[h3][b]New Christmas-based items[/b][/h3]
- Stickman skins: Santa + Mr Gingerbread
- Weapon skins: Iceball, Candy Sword + Fireworks Launcher
- Headgear: Christmas Beanie

[b]The above items are only buyable from 21st December till 4th January 2021. Purchasing would let you own them in your Armoury permanently![/b]

[h3][b]Lobby redesigned into a Christmas theme
[/b][/h3]The game's Lobby will be temporarily redesigned to feature Christmas-themed items.

[h3][b]All maps redesigned into a Christmas theme
[/b][/h3]The game's maps will be temporarily redesigned to feature Christmas-themed items, such as trees, snow, presents, and candy canes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657380/fcba3c8886622b3e347f323331aadec3af91341a.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]20% discount on all items
[/b][/h3]All stickman skins, weapons (excl. weapon skins), throwables (excl. stacks), and headgear prices will be at 20% OFF!

[b]Once again, please note that this discount doesn't apply for weapon skins and throwables' stacks!
[/b]
[h3][b]Battle of Santa mode
[/b][/h3]We also got some Santa action for you. You will be able to play in a brand new Battle of Santa mode in which you either protect Santa, or be his killer! Both teams (Santa's Protectors + Evil Elves) are controlled by real players. Here is everything you need to know about the mode!

[list]
[*] There are two teams: Santa's Protectors and Evil Elves, with a maximum of 6 players per team.
[*] Santa's Protectors have Mr Gingerbread, Iceball, any throwable and headgear equipped, whilst Evil Elves have Dark Elf with any weapon, throwable and headgear equipped — your current stickman skin will be temporarily replaced when joining the battle, even if you don't own the skin.
[*] The goal for the Santa's Protectors team is to protect Santa by not letting him die for 10 minutes in order to win the battle, whilst the goal for the Evil Elves team is to kill Santa before 10 minutes pass.
[*] Warm-Up Timer of 60 seconds; for as many players to join.
[*] 1 random player will turn into Santa.
[*] If Santa is killed, Evil Elves win the battle — otherwise, Santa's Protectors win after 10 minutes of protecting Santa!

[b]NOTES:[/b]
- You can't change equipment.
- If all Santa's Protectors leave the battle, then the Evil Elves team automatically wins!
- If all Evil Elves leave the battle, then the Santa's Protectors team automatically wins!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657380/6c2905f21f6ad0595d6d8733fe14a378e5697d73.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]...Even MORE![/b][/h3]
Our instincts want us to have more, so we know many of you are eager to buy as many items as possible in a short period of time, so during the last 24 hours of the celebrations (between 3rd and 4th January), you will experience Triple XP and Triple Battle Fund — meaning you will earn 9 coins and 90XP instead of 6 coins and 30XP per kill!

Lastly, we released some non-Christmas content and improvements, which can be found in the changelog! But we will go into detail about the new Battle Fund system!

[h3][b]Reworked Battle Fund
[/b][/h3]Battle Fund has been reworked, with the introduction of a new system; where the number of coins generated over the course of a battle is given to all participants depending on the player's performance in that battle. The fund is given based on a player's kills — you now earn 3 coins per kill. 

Previously the coins were distributed proportionally to all players at the end of each battle. We hope this new system will balance the earning of coins!

[code]- Added new stickman skins : Mr Gingerbread + Santa
- Added new weapon skins : Iceball + Candy Sword + Fireworks Launcher
- Added new weapon : Daggers
- Added new headgear : Christmas Beanie
- Added new game mode : Battle of Santa
- Added 20% discount on all items in the Armoury (excluding throwables' stacks)
- Added Triple XP + Triple Battle Fund (available 3rd January 2021)
- Redesigned all maps into a Christmas Theme
- Redesigned Lobby into a Christmas Theme
- Redesigned Ice Plains map
- Reworked Battle Fund : coins generated over the course of a battle are now given to all participants depending on the player's performance in that battle - you earn 3 coins per kill, where previously the coins were distributed proportionally to all players at the end of each battle
- Reworked Free-For-All (FFA) : decreased coins rewarding for Victory from 32 to 22, Draw from 21 to 15, Defeat from 17 to 12
- Reworked Conquer Points (CP) : decreased coins rewarding for Victory from 60 to 42, Draw from 40 to 28, Defeat from 32 to 22
- Reworked leveling up : you now earn diamonds instead of coins when leveling up
- Reworked Headgear system : improved headgear items' positioning
- Reworked Stone : decreased cooldown from 1.5s to 1s + increased damage inflicted from 75 to 85
- Reworked Javelin : decreased damage inflicted from 275 to 250
- Reworked Wizard Hat : increased health debuff from -25HP to -50HP + decreased chance to heal from 25% to 20%[/code]
See you on the battlefield!

[code]- Added new stickman skins : Frankenstein + Wizard Student + Enchantress

notes.title: [CHANGELOG] V2.0.2
notes.notes:
Hey Stickmen!

Changelog V2.0.2 is out now! 

We have added a new Brigida weapon skin : Oak Staff; reworked physics : even if the player dies, the projectile(s) and throwable(s) now continue their trajectory; reworked Desert Deep.

The full changelog:

[code]- Added new Brigida weapon skin : Oak Staff
- Added a system which shows a red ribbon with "NEW" text under recently released items
- Renamed "Prehistoric Bomb" to "Explosive Bomb"
- Reworked physics : even if the player dies, the projectile(s) and throwable(s) now continue their trajectory. Previously they were destroyed
- Reworked Conquer Points : conquered flag message is now based on team color. Previously it was green
- Redesigned Desert Deep
- Reworked Stickiller : AOE is now 35
- Fixed no respawn issue where previously sometimes a player couldn't respawn [/code]
See you on the battlefield!
